Decals and Letterings for Pajang Developments

Pajang Developments is a general contracting and construction management firm. They are known for their high-quality, and high-value work.

We’re Vinyl Wrap Toronto, a company that specializes in decals and letterings for businesses. We designed and installed decals and letterings on Pajang Developments’ Ford F-150 pickup truck recently, which helped to increase their brand visibility while they were on the road.

Pajang wanted us to put their logo, contact number, and website on their company pickup truck —and we were happy to help! These Avery brand vinyl decals increased their brand visibility by making them more recognizable as they drove around town.

If you’re looking for ways to market your business or organization while driving around town (and who isn’t?), then Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here for you! We can help with everything from designing your decals and letterings to installing it onto your car or truck.

We want to make sure that when people see our work on other vehicles around town, they know exactly who did it—because we believe in quality over quantity when it comes to our clients’ satisfaction.

If you would like to personalize your car, truck, boat, or other personal items – as long as it fits into our garage and has a smooth surface, we would love to wrap it! For your inspiration or your next decals and letterings with Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do not forget to check out our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote today by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
